description: Source file implementing configuration file reading and parsing functions for a software project, particularly for a prplMesh controller and agent configuration management. It includes functions to read various sections and parameters from configuration files, handle different configuration types, and process related settings like logging and backhaul configurations.

methods.name: bool read_log_section(const std::string & config_file_path,config_file::SConfigLog & sLogConf)
methods.description: Reads and processes the 'log' section of a configuration file, filling the SConfigLog structure with parsed values and ensuring that the log path has a trailing slash.

methods.name: bool read_master_config_file(const std::string & config_file_path,sConfigMaster & conf)
methods.description: Reads the master configuration for the controller, including general settings and logging, and ensures paths are correctly formatted.

methods.name: bool read_slave_config_file(const std::string & config_file_path,sConfigSlave & conf)
methods.description: Reads the slave/agent configuration, including backhaul and interface settings, and logging, across multiple radio slots.

methods.name: std::string getFileName(const std::string & s)
methods.description: Extracts and returns the filename component from a given path string.

methods.name: bool read_config_file(std::string config_file_path,tConfig & conf_args,const std::string & config_type)
methods.description: Generic function to read a specific section of a configuration file, parsing parameter lines based on expected argument patterns, with support for temporary override files in /tmp.
